name: UCSF ImmunoExplore Summer Camp
what_you_do: You can attend a free summer camp at UCSF's Parnassus campus with lectures, games, Q&A sessions, patient panels and live anatomy dissections. UCSF students and faculty mentor you.
who_can_apply: Bay Area high school students who may have limited opportunities to engage with biomedical research, per the page. Grade range and other rules are not stated.
duration: Not stated (summer camp; dates not posted)
deadline_text: The page says 2026 camper applications are open, but its title still reads Summer Camp 2025 and the summer 2026 camp has already passed. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Fill in the Google Form linked from the ImmunoExplore page.
notes: Re-read the ImmunoX page on 2026-10-07. It is titled Summer Camp 2025 but mentions 2026 applications, so it may be out of date. Grades, camp dates and deadlines are not posted. The apply link is the Google Form linked on the page. Confirm dates and grade range with ImmunoX before applying.
